description: To the payload corresponding JSON schema file is `Access.json`

access_token.description: The access token issued by the token endpoint, a UUID is security wise not recommended.

refresh_token.description: The refresh token to get a new access token, a UUID is security wise not recommended.

expires_in.description: The expiration time of the access token in seconds. The behavior of zero seconds is not specified, the value MUST be excluded (limited to a maximum of signed 32 bit).

scope.description:
One of the below described scopes (or an combination), predefined and specified in this API. Vendor defined scopes
are possible, but not considered here. 
- read 
- write 
- manage
